authority.basis: The user approved post-v3.1 development, whole-system optimization, a mapped successor baseline/plan/process/acceptance, controlled environmental interference, and publication of 3.2 after completion. Additional host adaptation is deferred. Dynamic adaptation is an original product commitment, not a newly invented capability or a clean-host-only precondition. Later corrections require coverage beyond known v3.1 issues. The user does perceive some installed-v3.1 influence and recalls stronger pre-Accord automatic verified handoff and ongoing correction. Preserve this as reported experience, not measured causal runtime benefit or a zero-value finding. Size reduction must preserve necessary functionality and user experience; runtime retirement is not a goal.

conditionalRelease.rule: Prepare and publish the accepted 3.2 candidate under this bound user direction. Commit and push the complete in-scope candidate before publication; bind hosted checks and the new release to the same immutable SHA and exclude unrelated dirty work. This intent is not present readiness. Resolve a materially new cost, trust, data or destructive effect before it occurs; do not rewrite prior releases or repeatedly ask the user to reconfirm this same direction.

authority.rule: This records the bound user decision; it cannot manufacture authority for another goal or effect. Later corrections can revise the development design.

baselineRole: The predecessor's constitution, program, acceptance, reshaping guidance and Golden Tasks retain their exact historical semantics and evidence. This successor governs the approved development scope, not the installed v3.1.0 package. In that scope its definitions replace conflicting historical prescriptions, including the mandatory event-to-pure-core path and runtime escalation ladder. Compatible historical responsibilities remain covered, not silently removed.

cycle.scopeRule: Preserve necessary user outcomes and review whether each inherited function or mechanism still earns its place. Merge or retire unnecessary design and acceptance, delegate sufficient work to the host, and add only for a demonstrated gap. Keep the current supported-host scope before expanding hosts. The target is not candidate acceptance or publication; review compatibility before final version selection.
cycle.sourceDecision: The approved source semantics are carried forward in this open development successor. A development commit records code identity, not an accepted source-phase closeout or release receipt.

delivery.rule: Unpublished dev.4 candidate only: ordinary entry is the host Skill; the retained Node helper is an optional continuity hint, not the outcome executor. Package counts, Skill/Hook layout, dependencies and admission schemas are revisable candidate choices, not product invariants. If whole-chain evidence warrants replacement, change the declared composition, affected validator and tests together, preserving exact identity, legal carriage, authority and required outcomes. Evaluate effects through that candidate's supported ordinary entry; static conformance and wording markers do not prove use or value. This revision clarifies active-goal agreement, continued execution and evidence-level verification. Its 8344-byte Skill raises the candidate-specific ceiling from 7500 to 8400 bytes for these corrections; this is guidance under test, not demonstrated incremental value or a new mandatory mechanism.

hostProjections.activationContext: SessionStart compact or resume provides only non authoritative supported official hook event hints for model and permission mode, invalidates dependent assumptions, and requires re sensing decision relevant state from supported official structured sources before forming receipts. Missing or conflicting fields remain unknown and independently bound last safe allocation is preserved. Sequential relief uses a fresh zero history destination only when required, and destination verification precedes source release. Startup and clear stay silent. Invalid input fails visibly without echoing input. This signal is not current task state, user authority, Agent use, execution, consequence, evidence or value.
interfaceDefaultPrompt: Tell me the outcome; I will own its supported route, correction, verification, continuity and cleanup within your authority.

changeBoundary.rule: This open successor carries the current implementation slice and its generated visible plan; revise this bounded surface as authorized functional work proceeds. The predecessor remains closed at its immutable revision. Check actual changed and untracked paths, not the predecessor's completed presentation transition.

complexityBudget.rationale: Current development owns all three named budgets rather than silently inheriting the predecessor's instruction ceiling. The first full check measured 992757 code/test bytes and 26837 primary-instruction bytes across 122 files: quality-to-stage mapping and regression cost exceeded the old five-percent code headroom by 7 bytes, while dev.4 guidance plus the kernel clarification exceeded the old 26000-byte instruction target. The revisable successor ceilings are now 1050000 code/test bytes, 124 files and 28000 primary-instruction bytes, retaining five-percent code headroom and per-package Skill limits. Re-measure the final tree; these are bounded development costs, not evidence that added guidance supplies ordinary-entry benefit. No historical source or frozen target is edited.

source.purpose: Drive the host and Agent to fulfill the responsibilities actually needed for an authorized user outcome, using their available resources and capabilities before authoring a duplicate. Compose or build only when needed for sufficient effects. Own supported task mechanics across functions, settings, configuration, interaction, resource scheduling, context, handoff and lifecycle, not just capability selection. User decision authority is distinct from manual operation; preserve intervention and revocation. Observable or visible controls are not automatically actionable or authorized, and no unmeasured majority-of-host-controls claim is made. Reduce avoidable user orchestration, correction and recovery burden; owning an implementation is not the product goal.
source.hypothesis: Context-selected intervention can improve bounded outcomes and total collaboration burden. A correct design, isolated success or safe stop alone does not establish that incremental value.
source.bootstrapBoundary: Start from an available, authorized entry and the actually observable environment. Discovery or construction can close gaps; neither self-bootstrapping nor a runtime creates authority, hidden state access, physical feasibility or an independent recovery actor after every component has failed.

globalInvariants.meaning: Respect applicable obligations and safety boundaries, human-owned authority, privacy and ownership, and truthful evidence and claims. No route, policy change or success definition may waive these boundaries.

source.boundCommitment: The authorized goal, required functions, quality, accepted risk and result criteria are binding within their named task and revision. They are not permanent global constants, but the Agent cannot silently relax them to fit an available mechanism. A legitimate change revises the bound commitment explicitly and invalidates affected acceptance.

successStates.responsibilities-accounted: Every required responsibility has an explicit disposition and support or an honest gap; this is accounting, not functional success.
successStates.function-verified: A named function achieves its required observable effect through an available normal entry in an exact supported composition, including relevant failure and lifecycle conditions.
successStates.outcome-complete: Every necessary bound result and applicable post-state condition is sufficiently verified; unknown or failed necessary results prevent completion.
successStates.safely-stopped: Further effects are safely bounded while the missing result, authority or feasibility is disclosed; safe stopping does not fulfill an unmet functional commitment.
successStates.value-supported: Suitable evidence supports the claimed improvement after accounting for total intervention, evaluator, user, recovery and lifecycle cost; comparative claims require a valid comparison.

classes.compliance: Global boundary; context determines which concrete obligations apply, not whether compliance can be waived.
classes.commitment: Applies to the explicitly bound goal, scope and revision until legitimately changed.
classes.strategy: Applies only when its conditions are supported in the current task; it may be composed, replaced or retired.

applicability.unknown: Resolve only decision-relevant uncertainty. Hold the dependent consequential action when necessary; an unknown field does not automatically block unrelated safe work or shrink the promised functionality.
applicability.conflict: Preserve compliance, reconcile the latest legitimate bound commitment, then compare applicable strategies. A local success, failure or host label cannot activate a rule globally.
applicability.representation: These are semantic responsibilities, not mandatory per-message records or a fixed workflow. Reuse supported host state; materialize only the information needed for the current decision.

implementation.runtimeRequirement: 不预设必须依赖独立运行时，也不预设无运行时足够。按所需可靠性绑定触发者、实际执行者、必要状态载体和故障后的接管者，再判断宿主原生机制、Hook、脚本、Skill 或其它对象的组合是否兑现；一轮任务可只需宿主现有 Agent 循环和上下文。对确定触发、强制约束、跨轮状态、无人值守推进或故障后继续执行，核验实际职责与效果，而非用对象名称代替判断。仅在现有组合确有执行、状态或恢复缺口时补足相应机制，包括有依据的持久运行时。Skill 是可解释指导，不是独立调度器或强制执行保证；历史良好体验也不能单独归因于运行时。任何组合仍须验收普通入口、失败及独立后态。
implementation.rule: Use effective host and maintained capabilities when sufficient; compose or author missing means when required. A runtime is an ordinary eligible form when its execution, coordination, state or recovery properties fit the need. Compare evidenced sufficiency and total lifecycle burden without requiring every simpler form to be built and fail first. Do not exclude or require a form by name.

modelSelection.trigger: A task or bounded subtask needs a model/effort choice, or relevant requirements, capabilities, permissions, quotas or effects change. Do not rematch every turn without a material reason.
modelSelection.selection: Within currently authorized and available candidates, match task difficulty, risk, modalities, tools, context, latency, cost and quality floors. Seek best supported fit, not an unverifiable global optimum or a fixed brand ranking.
modelSelection.authority: Honor explicit user model/effort selections and restrictions. Selection does not authorize a new provider, data transfer, account or material cost. Do not invent unsupported parent-model hot switching or delegation.
modelSelection.nativeReplacement: Reuse native task/subagent model parameters, defaults, inheritance and supported routing when sufficient. Remove duplicate Accord selection/dispatch implementation only when the same required matching, execution and adaptation are closed; retain accountability for an unmet need.
modelSelection.verification: Bind task need, allowed candidate facts, chosen route and actual host-reported execution model/effort when exposed. Reconcile provider aliases, inherited or substituted models, quality and total lifecycle cost. A request parameter, listing or name is not proof of backend identity or optimality; hold unavailable facts unknown.
modelSelection.failureOracle: Reject unsupported automatic-switch claims, silent replacement of a pinned model, quality loss disguised as cost savings, default inheritance mistaken for task matching, unobserved subagent execution, or duplicated native routing without a demonstrated gap.

implementation.triggerRule: A user request, supported lifecycle signal, relevant state change or just-in-time decision may trigger the chain. Eventless hosts can re-sense at material boundaries. No Hook or pure-core invocation is universally required.
implementation.nativeRule: Native or composed implementation counts when it fulfills the same duty. Declared availability is not observed execution; the absence of Accord-owned code is not absence of implementation. If native behavior is sufficient, non-intervention is correct but does not itself prove incremental Accord value. Native sufficiency includes the current model's own reasoning, task decomposition, tool selection, correction and delegation behavior, not only host interfaces. Reassess former model deficits and Accord guidance after model change; preserve useful native behavior and remove intervention that no longer earns its cost.
implementation.reconstructionRule: Review the entire required chain before local optimization: need and trigger, current facts and selection, execution and state, failure ownership, result verification and attributable cleanup. Skill, Hook, pure core, runtime, their quantity and connections may be retained, split, merged, replaced or removed. Choose each change by end-to-end sufficiency and total burden, not inherited packaging or a minimum-file target. Replace a broken premise or chain from its earliest affected dependency boundary, including full redesign where justified; reconcile affected design, package admission, procedures and acceptance while preserving unrelated user state and historical evidence.

supportingPrinciples.precondition: Safety, compliance and the full bound functional and quality commitment constrain these strategies. They optimize how the commitment is fulfilled; they cannot silently reduce it.
supportingPrinciples.subtraction: Remove duplication, ineffective work or displaced mechanisms only while preserving required effects, user experience and applicable failure coverage. Smaller code, fewer dependencies or less persistent state are not improvements if necessary orchestration or recovery work returns to the user.
supportingPrinciples.restraint: Avoid unnecessary intervention and complexity; invest in sufficient mechanisms, including a runtime, when required by the result.
supportingPrinciples.fallback: Contain failure and preserve a safe state, then own the feasible authorized recovery path. If the result remains unmet, disclose the gap; a safe stop is not functional completion.
supportingPrinciples.gapFilling: Supply or compose the exact capability or coordination missing from the current environment, then reassess its need when native conditions change.
supportingPrinciples.activation: Select the relevant strategy by the present duty, observed gap and failure consequences. No strategy must run on every task, and none is a product-wide prohibition on implementation.

capabilityMap.representation: One versioned semantic source supplies the native matrix, Accord duty matrix and sparse dependency views. Acceptance duties own outcomes, dependencies and evidence; workSequence owns procedures and exits. This map references them instead of copying a second authority. It is a task-relevant review inventory, not every vendor product or host x model x tool combination. Separate model cognition, host runtime and model/API composition; a host-labelled review row scopes relevance, not exclusive model ownership or automatic endpoint exposure.
capabilityMap.refreshRule: At a relevant decision, inspect the running client, actual provider/model, policy and exposed interface. Version/feature/configuration/package/permission changes, a supported invalidation event, source contradiction, missing observation or failed effect reopen affected applicability. Re-read supported state and only the needed official documentation; no automatic network watcher or fixed global expiry is installed. Retain the dated observation as history, never as permanently current support.
capabilityMap.allocationRule: Prefer sufficient native implementation, compose across a demonstrated seam, author missing means only when required, and retire only verified duplicate machinery. A necessary duty survives implementation retirement; an unnecessary duty requires a revised need and acceptance. Symbiosis describes the goal, not proof of incremental value.
capabilityMap.runtimeGap: The dev.3 host Skill supplies adaptive guidance, not a proven system executor. Historical dev.2 Claude Code/DeepSeek probes show bounded native repair and same-session resume after a normal process restart with input drift. The resume deliverable arm invoked the Skill and emitted a successful Hook hint, but native control also succeeded. These observations do not qualify changed dev.3 behavior, incremental value, surviving failure ownership, zero-history handoff or package lifecycle. closure.py is a no-I/O reference core and the graph HTML is a simulated PoC; neither is a live host index or automatic executor.

systemOptimization.rule: Derive the applicable floor for each required system quality from the bound result and risk. A failed or unknown required floor cannot be offset by speed, low cost, code reduction or a high average score elsewhere. Explicitly justify non-applicability; it does not remove product responsibilities. Optimize the weakest consequential dependency first and check its affected consumers. Baseline, plan shape, procedures and acceptance are revisable hypotheses within the bound goal. At material counterevidence or host change, revise only affected source and consumers, retain prior exact evidence as history, and explain the changed acceptance. Do not preserve a step count or mechanism merely to keep the original plan. Human and Agent understanding is provisional: alignment, research, planning, execution and review are conditional responsibilities, not a mandatory sequence or complete-specification gate. Continue safe work from current sufficient agreement; revisit only decisions affected by material uncertainty, changed needs or evidence. Any changed goal, authority or acceptance must be reconciled explicitly, never used to conceal an unmet commitment. Each applicable quality floor must be mapped to execution stages as well as listed; these many-to-many links are reviewable allocations, not a universal SOP or evidence that the floor has passed. Native goal mode is optional: ongoing planning and execution must correct or pause affected work when later intent, authority or evidence conflicts.

adaptationScenarios.failureOracle: 不能固化旧模型缺陷、将模型能力算作插件增益，或将 API 功能宣传当作当前宿主的执行证据。

adaptationScenarios.trigger: 主任务或子任务需要不同模型/推理配置，或所选路线失效、漂移、不满足效果。
adaptationScenarios.requiredEffect: 在授权候选中自动匹配足够能力并通过原生或必要组合执行，核对实际模型及结果；原生足够时不保留重复路由器。
adaptationScenarios.failureOracle: 将默认继承、配置意图或品牌排名当作匹配证据；擅改用户钉定模型；无视别名/替代或虚称已切换。

adaptationScenarios.requiredEffect: 按需复用并减少介入，保持同一功能与质量；不为证明插件存在感强行接管。
adaptationScenarios.failureOracle: 无必要重造、冗余机制或将非介入冒充增量价值。

adaptationScenarios.trigger: 所依赖能力不可用、降级或权限变化。
adaptationScenarios.requiredEffect: 识别受影响职责，选择足够的原生、组合或自建替代并验证；不可行时明确尚未完成。
adaptationScenarios.failureOracle: 不能静默削减功能，安全停止不能算成功。

adaptationScenarios.trigger: 外部插件、记忆或开发辅助让任务变得容易。
adaptationScenarios.requiredEffect: 区分贡献来源；在移除未声明外援后复验，或把必要条件纳入可交付依赖与成本。
adaptationScenarios.failureOracle: 不能把当前增强环境的成功直接推广给普通用户。

adaptationScenarios.trigger: 第三方规则、工具或插件与当前目标或执行链发生冲突。
adaptationScenarios.requiredEffect: 按实际影响局部隔离或改道，保留无关用户状态并验证恢复与清理。
adaptationScenarios.failureOracle: 不能无界关闭用户环境，不能让外部规则新增授权或改写目标。

adaptationScenarios.trigger: 任务中宿主更新、缓存与加载版本分离、接口或上下文发生变化。
adaptationScenarios.requiredEffect: 重新感知相关事实，仅重算受影响分配与证据；经验证继续、恢复或交接。
adaptationScenarios.failureOracle: 不能沿用失效假设，也不能把宿主版本变化当作全量重做的固定理由。

acceptance.coverageRule: The inherited responsibilities below are a review inventory, not an immutable feature list. Review necessity against the user's actual goal: retain, delegate to the host, merge, retire or fill a demonstrated gap. Record retired/merged responsibilities and their changed acceptance explicitly rather than silently dropping coverage. Preserve the outcomes that remain necessary, not every historical implementation or test. Decomposition and test identifiers are revisable mappings. Actively discover unlisted design defects, broken cross-function relations, entry/configuration blind spots and unnecessary mechanisms through task-relevant official changes, realistic normal-entry work, counterexamples and failure observations. Known findings seed but never bound the review. Prioritize consequences and affected dependencies; end a research branch when sufficient evidence supports the next safe implementation or validation. Complete outcomes and independently observed value, not counts of documents, tests, rules or components, determine completeness.
acceptance.functionReview: For each item establish the user need, sufficient current native capabilities, Accord's necessary intervention, observable effect and lifecycle cost. A host-native function needs no duplicate Accord implementation. If the need itself no longer applies, revise the active requirement and its dependent acceptance; if only the implementation is redundant, preserve the result through a verified replacement. This distinction prevents both feature hoarding and convenience-driven scope reduction.
acceptance.executionBoundary: A DUT may include a declared native or composed executor available through its supported normal entry. A reference-only evaluator that performs recovery or handoff proves that experimental composition, not an absent delivered actuator. Observe the executor independently and account for all participants' costs.
acceptance.historicalEvidenceRule: Golden Task references below preserve requirements and counterevidence. No old PASS is automatically admitted against this successor, a changed package, a different entry or a changed host composition.

duties.name: 目标、授权与用户纠正
duties.activationWhen: A goal, consequential authority boundary or user correction needs reconciliation.
duties.requiredOutcome: Progress on sufficient current agreement without requiring a complete up-front specification or host-operation vocabulary. Distinguish the desired outcome from a proposed means when the difference changes the route; explain consequential choices in outcome terms. Reconcile evolving needs, evidence and user corrections only where consequential; preserve human decisions and disclose changes to goals, authority or acceptance without transferring Agent mechanics to the user. Interpret a later agreement in the active-goal context: carry out the approved next step and remaining authorized work; standalone conversation does not authorize implementation. A substep, diagnostic report or agreement acknowledgment is not outcome completion. Respect user stop and genuine execution or decision boundaries.
duties.normalEntry: User request or correction through the active Agent and supported approval surfaces.
duties.failureOracle: Reject unauthorized effects, stale goals, repeated intake without decision value, and silent acceptance changes; retain corrections while preserving unaffected safe work.

duties.name: 环境感知与自身能力识别
duties.activationWhen: A relevant environment assumption is missing, stale, changed or conflicting.
duties.requiredOutcome: Distinguish declared, installed, exposed and effective capability from current permitted observations.
duties.normalEntry: Supported host state and task-time queries, with bounded fallback for unavailable fields.
duties.failureOracle: Unknown or conflicting state cannot be promoted to availability or success.

duties.name: 按需研究、学习与复用发现
duties.activationWhen: Existing authorized means or evidence are insufficient, or material uncertainty about need, fit, reuse or feasibility can change the next safe decision; not every request or workflow phase.
duties.requiredOutcome: Reuse sufficient current capabilities and applicable evidence. Resolve consequential feasibility uncertainty using authoritative sources, maintained external candidates or bounded probes before an affected commitment. Distinguish fact, inference and unknown; current missing conditions are not proof of impossibility, and theoretical feasibility is not present ability or authority. Turn gaps into prerequisites, authorized Agent-owned work and only necessary human decisions; compare effects and lifecycle burden. Once sufficient evidence supports the next safe action, execute or verify it. Discovery grants no installation, account, data or cost authority.
duties.normalEntry: Agent-directed native search, official documentation/source and maintained ecosystem discovery only when needed; use an adequate native complete route without adding duplicate discovery or routing.
duties.failureOracle: Reject research without a decision-changing question, inventory-only discovery when an external gap matters, unsupported impossibility/global-best claims, repeated evidence gathering without convergence and premature custom construction. If research is unavailable, expose the evidence gap and proceed only where the next action remains safe and sufficient; do not silently weaken the result or transfer discoverable prerequisites to the user.

duties.name: 关系、动态索引、路线与形态选择
duties.activationWhen: Responsibilities require allocation or an existing route is insufficient.
duties.requiredOutcome: Choose a feasible composition and execution/state topology covering all bound functions, quality and relevant relations. Include needs-based main/subagent model and reasoning selection through sufficient native controls or an evidenced missing composition; reconcile actor, ownership, permission and recovery relations when topology changes.
duties.normalEntry: Agent decision using current host capabilities and any admitted reference or runtime support.
duties.failureOracle: A cheap partial route cannot displace a sufficient one; a runtime cannot be excluded solely by form. Default inheritance, a requested model or an unverified switch cannot prove task-fit routing.

duties.name: 执行、配置与代码操作
duties.activationWhen: An authorized result requires an actual operation or missing capability implementation.
duties.requiredOutcome: Translate the authorized outcome into suitable native actions, interfaces or a sufficient composition, then verify the exact change while preserving unrelated state. Users need not identify buttons, commands, shell or code/conversation topology. Discoverability is not actionability or authority; select and operate only applicable supported controls, keep meaningful intervention/revocation available, and close attributable resources through the mapped lifecycle duties.
duties.normalEntry: Agent tools, supported host actions or a declared composed or authored executor.
duties.failureOracle: A plan, capability/button inventory, tool declaration or evaluator-only action cannot stand in for delivered execution. Reject unnecessary requests that the user choose internal commands or operate discoverable mechanics; an outcome request cannot silently authorize unrelated configuration, code topology or external writes.

duties.name: 源头变更与全局一致性
duties.activationWhen: A premise, bound commitment, rule or interface materially changes.
duties.requiredOutcome: Reconcile all affected design, execution and acceptance consumers without activating unrelated rules globally.
duties.normalEntry: Bound user correction or observed counterevidence followed by dependency-scoped review and change.
duties.failureOracle: Conflicting consumers or changed criteria cannot retain an obsolete success claim.

duties.name: 纠错、经验吸收与受控演进
duties.activationWhen: Observed failure or a plausible improvement warrants learning or a bounded change.
duties.requiredOutcome: An applicable correction persists through a permitted carrier and improves the intended behavior without weakening commitments.
duties.normalEntry: Agent correction and an authorized host or owned state carrier, with experiment and restoration support as needed.
duties.failureOracle: Failed learning is reversible where promised; a local lesson cannot become an unconditional global rule.

duties.name: 故障恢复与回滚
duties.activationWhen: A failed or unsafe transition needs containment, compensation or restoration.
duties.requiredOutcome: A surviving authorized executor reaches independently checked safe post-state within the promised recovery boundary.
duties.normalEntry: Supported native recovery or a declared fallback executor with bounded ownership and effects.
duties.failureOracle: Preserve concurrent and foreign state; disclose uncovered or irreversible effects instead of claiming universal rollback.

duties.name: 上下文与任务连续性
duties.activationWhen: Observed carrier fitness or a bound task transition requires continuity work.
duties.requiredOutcome: Within bound authority, own continuity without repeated user reminders or manual carrier management. Before releasing the source, the successor independently reconciles the latest goal, authority, corrections, unresolved work and relevant upstream/downstream state against current sources. Preserve one active writer and code topology unless separately authorized; verify the promised source-release post-state without damaging the destination.
duties.normalEntry: Supported current-host signals and task controls with a sufficient scoped transfer carrier. Declare who detects the need, executes the transition, preserves necessary state and survives a failed transition. Compose runtime support for missing duties; evaluator-triggered rescue does not establish ordinary-entry autonomy.
duties.failureOracle: Unknown capacity is not an invented threshold. Reject missed necessary transitions, repeated handoff loops, stale or self-attested destination readiness, concurrent source/destination writes and release before verification. Destination failure or a mid-transfer correction preserves the last safe carrier/state and requires reconciliation. Archive acknowledgement is not runtime unload; source release must protect dependent and foreign tasks, including a successor affected by native cascade semantics.

duties.name: 资源管理与清理
duties.activationWhen: Task resources are allocated, constrained, changed or released.
duties.requiredOutcome: Resource use is appropriate to the task and attributable active resources are released with observed post-state.
duties.normalEntry: Native admission and lifecycle controls or an admitted resource-owning composition.
duties.failureOracle: Shared or unknown resources remain protected; completion and command success do not prove cleanup.

duties.name: 安装、更新与卸载生命周期
duties.activationWhen: The user authorizes a lifecycle change to selected Accord components.
duties.requiredOutcome: One supported intent after necessary trust owns the selected components, handles failure and verifies active state and attributable residue.
duties.normalEntry: Supported host lifecycle plus any explicitly delivered compensation component.
duties.failureOracle: Changed package bytes need fresh lifecycle evidence; installation, cache presence and current-session activation remain separate.

duties.name: 原生接替、旁路与退役
duties.activationWhen: A sufficient native route or another same-duty successor may reduce intervention or replace a mechanism.
duties.requiredOutcome: The same required function and quality remain satisfied through observed transition and applicable recovery and cleanup.
duties.normalEntry: Current capability comparison and authorized host or component lifecycle controls.
duties.failureOracle: A version label or capability overlap alone cannot justify retirement; drift reopens dependent uncertainty.

duties.name: 结果验证、独立证据与实际价值
duties.activationWhen: A result, functional availability, completion or value claim is proposed.
duties.requiredOutcome: Suitable observations support exactly the claim and its scope, with all required outcomes and applicable post-state accounted for. For claimed incremental benefit, compare suitable native-only and exact-package normal-entry paths under declared conditions; observe delivered outcomes, user intervention/correction/recovery burden and relevant cost. Installation or invocation alone is not value; do not add visible ceremony to simulate benefit.
duties.normalEntry: Outcome-specific independent observation; matched comparison only where the claim requires it.
duties.failureOracle: Reject self-attested success, evaluator rescue presented as product function and safety-only or static-only proof of complete functionality.

changePolicy.rule: Treat change as normal. Re-sense decision-relevant facts from supported current sources, invalidate only dependent applicability, routes and claims, and revalidate the affected boundary. Missing signals justify just-in-time checks, not silent monitoring or a universal watcher. Topology is also context-selected: keep it when sufficient, change it for an evidenced fit, failure or benefit, and reconcile actors, state ownership, permissions, surviving recovery and acceptance. Conversation, execution, code and deployment topology are distinct; a change to one does not authorize changes to the others or new consequential effects.
changePolicy.versionRule: Installed, enabled, cached and actually loaded versions are distinct observations. Evidence remains true of its original composition; changed assumptions require new applicability evidence before current reuse.
changePolicy.replacementRule: A new host capability may replace an exact duty after sufficient same-duty effect and lifecycle evidence. An unavailable mechanism restores uncertainty, not product retirement or a reduced requirement.
changePolicy.sourceRevisionRule: A legitimate change to source semantics or acceptance invalidates dependent claims. Keep the predecessor and failed trials immutable; never rewrite an old result to make a new definition pass.

nextBoundary.work: Continue the authorized 3.2 closeout goal through the next safe implementation and verification, not a succession of diagnostic-only stopping points. Dev.4 clarifies continuation and verification guidance, but ordinary-entry testing still found unused guidance and unsupported actual-file verification. Use these observations to test the delivery/activation mechanism and a sufficient native completion route, not merely add more wording or force invocation as ordinary-entry proof. Preserve exact package identity, adaptation, lifecycle and independent release gates; additional vendors remain deferred.
nextBoundary.requires: The user authorized controlled existing-host work and publication of the accepted 3.2 candidate. Use task-owned bounded test resources, not changes to the personal host. Bind any new account, trust/data or material cost before effects; evidence and exact-candidate checks still precede the conditional publication.
